auth.statement: Every writer keeps a bookshelf of their own.

batch.readinessIssueNoWorkBody: The target chapters already contain outline, prose, and state results, so this run would make no model requests.

batch.readinessIssueUnknownBody: Check code: {code}. Run the check again or inspect the backend log.
batch.progressTokensNote: (idempotently counted per Provider attempt, including failures)
batch.reasonCheckpoint: Reached a planned checkpoint. Review this window, then resume.
batch.reasonConflict: Consistency conflict hit — paused. Review the conflicts below before resuming.
batch.reasonCostCap: Token budget reached; paused at a chapter boundary. Raise the budget and resume, or abort.

batch.reasonInterrupted: The previous run was interrupted. If a Provider request may have been sent, explicitly retry or skip it to avoid silent duplicate charges.
batch.uncertainDetail: Retrying uses a new attempt and the Provider may charge both calls. Skipping marks the job failed so you can inspect or complete the chapter manually.
